def format_id_prefixed(prefix, n, width):
    return prefix + str(n).zfill(width)

def format_id_suffixed(n, width, suffix):
    return str(n).zfill(width) + suffix

def sequential_ids(prefix, start, count, width):
    return [prefix + str(start + i).zfill(width) for i in range(count)]

note: Zero-padding of negative n uses str.zfill (sign counted within width, since this spec lacks the explicit sign carve-out fmt-191 states); untested by the visible examples.

def format_hex_id(n, width):

import re


def safe_slug_filename(name, max_len):
    lowered = name.lower()
    slug = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', lowered)
    slug = slug.strip('-')
    truncated = slug[:max_len]
    if truncated.endswith('-'):
        truncated = truncated.rstrip('-')
    return truncated
